facts.log_hook: How the library's log output can be redirected.
facts.assert_hook: How the library's assertion failures can be redirected, and whether that is decided at the library's build time or at runtime.
facts.query: How glue can read back the installed hooks.

rules.text: Every library whose log output can be redirected at runtime routes it through the diagnostics facade.
Every library whose assertion failures can be redirected at runtime routes them through the diagnostics facade.
Libraries whose assert macro is fixed when the library is built can only be routed through a variant built with the composition's macro.
